senses.gloss:
1. यु यु, ii. 2, Par., and ii. 9, युना, युनि, Par. Ātm.
 1. To bind.
 2. To [] join, to mix.
 3. To separate (? cf. 2. यु). Ptcple of the pf. pass. युत,
 1. Joined, connected, Rām. 3, 52, 26.
 2. United, Lass. 39, 19.
 3. Attached to.
 4. Endowed, full of, Nal. 12, 2; Chr. 13, 9; Hit. i. d. 152, M.M. (seized).
 --Comp.
 --With the prep. व्यति वि-अति, To mix, Bhaṭṭ. 8, 6.- With आ आ, आयुत, Endowed, Nal. 12, 39.
 --With प्र प्र, प्रयुत, Joined. n. A million.
 --With सम् सम्, संयुत,
 1. Joined, mixed.
 2. Heaped, Śāk. 69, 15.
 3. Endowed, Sāv. 5, 33; Pañc. iii. d. 48.
 4. Implying, Man. 2, 32.
 --Comp.
 --Cf. Lat. juvare, jus (= ved. योस्), jubere (Caus.); ζώννυμι (probably for ζωσνυμι), ζώνη, ζῶστρον.

2. यु यु, ii. 3, Par. To keep back.
 --Caus., and i. 10, Ātm. † To despise.
 --With the prep. अप अप, ii. 3, To remove, Chr. 295, 11 = Rigv. i. 92, 11.
यू यू, f. Pease soap (cf. युष).
